//: A stricter check over the test tree, which the shipped tsconfig excludes.
tsconfig.json excludes `src/test` outright, so `npm run typecheck` has never
looked at a single test file. That hid 28 real errors across three test files
that were already written in TypeScript and already looked correct.
`src/vite-env.d.ts` is in `include` because it declares the ImportMetaEnv
global that src/config.ts reads. Without it this config reports two phantom
errors in a file it was never meant to be checking.
Verification-only: not wired to any npm script, and safe to delete.
